summary: Solid Grade-3 tree-diagram pair with strong Detective Dot voice, optional-puppet flexibility plus a body-based human-tree no-materials version, and a worksheet whose 3 parts mirror the lesson stations cleanly. Three lesson-side categories sit at 3: alignment lacks a forward bridge to Day 2/Day 5; pedagogical_depth has a real cross-branching trap but no diagnostic-branched recovery and no research citation; mathematical_authenticity stays conceptual but never lets children compare strategies or anchors the trap in named research. Worksheet is fine — fixes are all in lesson_01.
